description: Search through a massive collection of video game cheats, codes, and walkthroughs. Cheat Database covers thousands of games across 30+ platforms — from classic retro consoles to modern systems. Just ask for cheats by game name and get instant results with cheat codes, tips, unlockables, and full walkthroughs. Whether you're stuck on a level or looking for hidden secrets, this app gives you quick access to one of the largest community-built cheat databases on the web.
